rule: Each restricted edit is placed by two plain covariates, its effective scale along the full top-8 edit (s_eff = edit scale x sqrt(kept squared-norm share)) and its kept share, and its count is read off by interpolating the stored hard328-cue right-answer counts of edits indexed by those same covariates: the full-share scale curve (s 0 / 0.5 / 1 / 1.5 / 2 -> 164 / 170 / 192 / 203 / 190, result-6f1bb7, result-284db5) at kept = 1, and the partial-share cells at kept about 0.3-0.55 (rank-1 at 1x / 2x / 3x: kept 0.42 from weights/anatomy top1/top8 -> s_eff 0.65 / 1.30 / 1.94 -> 181 / 184 / 168; layer bands at 1.5x: kept 0.33 / 0.29 / 0.38 -> 184 / 183 / 166; attention-only / MLP-only at 1x: kept 0.54 / 0.46 -> 178 / 181; result-51a0e7, result-306787), linearly in kept share between the two; the norm-matched leftover outside the kept share is given the stored effect of equal-norm unstructured edits (random rank-8 158-167, shifted pairs 160, own-direction 155/168: about -1 to -3 vs base 164, result-0d54f3, result-87e495); kept shares come from result-ce52f8 (m=64 readers/writers 0.757/0.780, m=8 0.398/0.416); intervals cover one-sample noise (about +-9 of 328) plus the spread among the partial-share cells.
